snippet.title: Tenebris Somnia - Official Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Get a fresh look at Tenebris Somnia in this creepy new trailer for the upcoming 2D retro survival horror adventure game with live-action cutscenes created by an award-winning film crew from Argentina. Unveil the depths of a disturbing story by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures. ...What if they aren't just nightmares? Tenebris Somnia will be available on PC.
